scene:
The picture has three parts read left to right, separated by thin vertical navy lines. The parts have no headings.

On the left third, two pyramids joined. Two small stepped pyramids of stacked blocks stand side by side, each three levels high. The left pyramid is teal, with a tiny calendar icon on its top block; above it the label CUSTOMER OUTCOME; on its bottom row a small clock icon with the label 80 HOURS PER SETUP. The right pyramid is ochre, with a tiny stack of plain, blank coins (no currency symbols, no banknotes) on its top block; above it the label BUSINESS OUTCOME; on its top block the label NET REVENUE RETENTION. Between the two pyramids, at middle height, one shared block bridges both like a keystone, outlined in bold navy, labelled FIRST SCHEDULE ≤ 8 WEEKS.

In the middle third, an honest clock: a vertical timeline running TOP to BOTTOM with a navy arrow pointing down, and three stops, each with an icon on the left and a label on the right: a stopwatch labelled SETUP HOURS: WEEKS; a calendar page labelled FIRST SCHEDULE: A QUARTER; a blank sheet of paper with a signature line inside a circular arrow, with NO words on or inside the icon, labelled RENEWAL: A YEAR. Icons carry no lettering of their own. Beside the timeline between the first and second stop, a small ochre flag with eight tiny customer figures, labelled DAY 90: FIRST COHORT.

On the right third, balance as a budget: one large round pie cut into three slices of different sizes, each slice with one icon and one label: a rocket labelled NEW CAPABILITIES, a wrench and upward arrow labelled IMPROVEMENTS, a gear labelled RUNNING. Above the pie, a ruler-and-scissors icon with the label SPLIT BEFORE RANKING.

TEXT: draw exactly these labels, each once and nothing else: CUSTOMER OUTCOME, 80 HOURS PER SETUP, BUSINESS OUTCOME, NET REVENUE RETENTION, FIRST SCHEDULE ≤ 8 WEEKS, SETUP HOURS: WEEKS, FIRST SCHEDULE: A QUARTER, RENEWAL: A YEAR, DAY 90: FIRST COHORT, NEW CAPABILITIES, IMPROVEMENTS, RUNNING, SPLIT BEFORE RANKING. Any other text is a defect.
alt: A customer-outcome pyramid, with 80 hours per setup at its base, and a business-outcome pyramid topped by net revenue retention are joined by one shared block: first schedule within eight weeks; a downward timeline shows setup hours read within weeks, first schedule within a quarter and renewal within a year, with the first cohort reviewed at day 90; a pie split into new capabilities, improvements and running is divided before ranking.
caption: One customer outcome and one business outcome joined at a shared measure, an honest clock for when each measure can be read, and a plan split before ranking.
